If you don't want it the easy way, then it will be completely different.
A brave warrior will never tell you anything!

Then we will take all your valuable property.
Wait one minute, no need for any punishments!
Are you ready to tell the truth before the whole army?
Yes, I will tell everything and show the place!
Well then show quickly, where is the treasure hidden?
Over there, right next to the old oak!
